# Maximum Pixel — Video Production & Editing Studio

> Maximum Pixel is a Jaipur-based video production and post-production studio creating commercial films, brand videos, product shoots, and editing for brands, businesses, and creators.

## Studio Overview
- **Brand**: Maximum Pixel
- **Tagline**: Ideas into visuals. Stories into impact. From the first frame to the final cut.
- **Location**: Jaipur, Rajasthan, 302001, India
- **Founders**: Krishna Rajak (Founder & Creative Lead), Vishwajeet Barman (Co-Founder & Visual Lead), Rahul Gyanchandani (Co-Founder & Strategist)
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 78787 36798
- **Email**: info@maximumpixel.online | hello.maximumpixel@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://www.maximumpixel.online

## Core Services
1. **Video Production**: Professional video shoots for brands, businesses, products and campaigns.
2. **Video Editing**: Editing, pacing, sound design, colour correction and final finishing.
3. **Complete Shoot + Edit**: Complete production process, from the camera to the final export.
4. **Creative Direction**: Visual planning, concepts, references and storytelling.

## Standard Pricing (INR, Effective 24 November 2026)
- **1 Reel, Shoot + Edit (30–40 sec)**: ₹1,700 / reel
- **1 Reel, Edit Only (30–40 sec)**: ₹800 / reel
- **Product Video (15–30 sec)**: ₹1,000 / product
- **Half-Day / Full-Day Video Shoot**: ₹2,500 / ₹4,500
- **Product Photography**: ₹400 / product (4 edited photos), bulk tiers from ₹3,500 (10) to ₹14,000 (50)
- **Lifestyle / Artisan Photoshoot**: ₹1,200 (Mini) / ₹3,000 (Half day) / ₹5,500 (Full day)
- **Monthly Shoot + Edit Packages**: ₹8,100 (6 reels) / ₹15,000 (12 reels) / ₹24,500 (20 reels)
- **Monthly Edit-Only Packages**: ₹4,500 (6 reels) / ₹8,400 (12 reels) / ₹13,000 (20 reels)
